verdict.rationale: Superpowers' core workflow explicitly delegates engineering tasks to subagents that implement, review, and iterate autonomously for hours (superpowers-gh-3, superpowers-gh-6, superpowers-gh-10, superpowers-docs-11, superpowers-docs-60), which matches the 'delegate to a built-in AI assistant' story. However, community reports note the self-review subagent step was recently folded back into the main agent (superpowers-comm-3) and mixed real-world effectiveness (superpowers-comm-2), and the 'assistant' is not a standalone built-in AI but relies on an external host agent (Claude Code, Devin, etc.) to run. Missing for 10: independent verification that delegated subagent work is reliably higher quality, and evidence of a fully self-contained assistant not dependent on a third-party host CLI.
